title: Mixed Event — A Bright Future!! — Episode8 Opening Doors

meta.Event Outline: Bit by bit, the members of Leo/need continue preparations for their first show together. Their new song is coming along well, and all that's left is for Ichika to add her lyrics. She's determined to express the feelings that Saki put into the composition, but will it be so easy...?

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, that was so much fun!
My heart's still pounding...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Saki.
There's no way to temper that excitement, is there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's because I am really excited!
I still can't believe that we really got to do a show together like this♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. It was a lot of fun...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, when's our next one gonna be?
I can't wait to do another one!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hold your horses, Saki.
Let's talk about how today's show went first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aww, come one!
Can't we celebrate just a little bit...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No. We need to discuss everything while it's still fresh in our heads.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, Shihooo...! You're like one of those really mean drill sergeants from the movies...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You could just stop coming to practice, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That was a joke! I was joking, okay?! I promise to keep practicing! I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'll be right there with you, Saki. Let's keep doing what we can for us and our next show, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
Hehe. Our next show...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I have to think that people are starting to warm up to us. Especially considering how small our audience was today...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is pretty par for the course...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's beyond rare to see anyone have any interest in a band that literally no one's ever heard of.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But some of them got really into it!
I even heard a couple of them say that they really liked what we played!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. So did I!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Not many people were here to actually hear us play our song, but we definitely reached some of them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As long as we keep at it, that number will keep increasing. So let's keep trying our best.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We took a big first step as Leo/need today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It wasn't exactly a great success or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm so glad that we actually managed to get through to some people...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well, it's just...
I was thinking about how I could turn how I feel right now into lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're ready to write another song?
I'd love to read what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
How you feel right now means...
It's gonna be a super happy song, right♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll see once I get a chance to put pen to paper.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm able to express how I truly feel without holding back because I have them here with me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Because of what we did today as Leo/need. Because we're together.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's okay for me to feel confident about what I write... Now, I know that.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, it's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm just hoping that we get to keep playing our own music like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I hope so too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, once we're done with this debrief, shall we start discussing our next song?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's think up some music that goes perfectly with Ichi's lyrics!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll make sure to contribute to the next one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And we'll be looking forward to seeing what you come up with, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So am I...!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Phew! We're doing great today too☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Especially, you, KAITO. I can't put my finger on it, but something seems different about the way you're playing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's like...
You're really happy!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I sensed that too. Almost as if each note is jumping for joy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I suppose so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the girls were finally able to step through that door.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. That means we have to keep doing what we can too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We're not about to let them leave us behind, are we?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No way! We need to keep doing everything we can as their seniors.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So how does one more song sound?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure...
